Definition: a Partsite (collectively) or descendants of Perets
BiblicalUsage: Partsiy is a Partsite, a descendant of Perez, of the family of Pharez. It appears once, in Numbers 26:20, where the sons of Judah are counted by their families, and of Pharez come the family of the Hezronites and the family of the Hamulites, and the Partsite line is named among them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the families are counted because the promise runs through them, and the line of Perez is the line the Messiah will come from.
